detail.longDescription: Anthropic reports quarterly revenue swelling to $17 billion but still posts a net loss for the latest three months. The AI giant released this update in an IPO filing on Monday. The company behind the Claude chatbot has committed to spending $895.4 billion on AI computing and infrastructure, including $70 billion in the next 12 months. This comes about a week after Anthropic's original IPO filing, preparing for a blockbuster Wall Street debut later this month. Despite revenue growing 13 times to $33.2 billion for the year, the company reported a net loss of $104 billion.
